subject: Simple class condition
notes: kb/Work PB571. All three arms of SR1 are screened at the ONE class-condition operand screen, which every spelling of the condition reaches (the IF form, 14.9.13.3 SR5's identifier-less form, and the EVALUATE selection subject's own class test, which used to be bound by a separate copy). The class list is asked through ItemCategory.IsIndexMessageTagObjectOrPointer for a data-item reference - the population that also answers for MESSAGE-TAG and FUNCTION-POINTER, whose entries never gain a PicInfo - and through IntrinsicArgumentRules.ClassOf for the operand shapes that are not one (an index-NAME, an intrinsic of 15.2 item 6's index class, the NULL predefined address). The variable-length group arm delegates to ReferenceResolver.HasVariableLengthSubordinate, which IS 8.5.1.12.1's definition. The strongly-typed-group arm keeps the COBOL1533 strong-typing family's own code (that family is split by rule) and the other two are COBOL2200; the split is stated in the code so it is not re-argued.
